description: Price a parlay with @buzzr/bets-core: removes the vig from each leg, combines the fair leg probabilities into a fair parlay price, and reports the edge of the offered combined odds. With a stake, also returns expected profit and expected ROI.

legs.description: Every leg of the parlay, each with both sides of its market.

opposite.description: Offered American odds for the other side of the leg.

selected.description: Offered American odds for the picked side of the leg.

offeredAmericanOdds.description: Combined parlay price the book is offering. Defaults to the product of the selected leg prices when omitted.

stake.description: Optional stake; adds expected-value math to the result.

name: parlay_value
title: Parlay fair value
